description: Amazon ABA & Business Insights: opportunity/search By Metrics API.

amazonDomain.description: Amazon site code (closed enumeration), currently only supports `US`; if not specified, only the US site will be checked by default.

demoLifeStageTagsContains.description: Life stage tag fragment (snake_case, LIKE), such as `parent`, `student`, `retiree`, `athlete`.

demoPrimaryAgeMaxGte.description: The minimum value of the upper bound of the age of the main population.

demoPrimaryAgeMaxLte.description: The maximum value of the upper bound of the age of the host group.

demoPrimaryAgeMinGte.description: The minimum value of the lower bound of the age of the main population.

demoPrimaryAgeMinLte.description: The maximum value of the lower bound of the age of the host group.

featureEmergingTrendTagsContains.description: Emerging trend feature tag fragments (snake_case, LIKE), such as `cordless`, `portable`, `smart`.

featureEstablishedAvgReviewCountAtLeastG.description: The lower limit of the average number of comments for mature and old products.

featureEstablishedAvgReviewCountAtLeastL.description: The upper limit of the average number of comments for mature and old products.

featureNewAvgReviewCountAtLeastGte.description: The lower limit for the average number of reviews for new products.

featureNewAvgReviewCountAtLeastLte.description: The upper limit of the average number of reviews for new products.

featureTop5BrandSharePctAtLeastGte.description: The lower limit of the total share of the top 5 brands.

featureTop5BrandSharePctAtLeastLte.description: The upper limit of the total share of the top 5 brands.

featureTopBrandsContains.description: Top 3 brand name fragments (original text LIKE, case sensitive).

featureUncommonFeatureTagsContains.description: Rare differentiation feature tag fragments (snake_case, LIKE), such as `hema_free`, `medical_grade_silicone`.

keyword.description: Search keyword text fragments (LIKE fuzzy matching).

limit.description: Returns the upper limit of the number of items; without the `page` parameter, the most recent N items are returned in reverse order of collection time.

nicheBrandCountYoyChangePctAtLeastGte.description: The lower limit of the year-on-year change rate of the number of brands (%, with sign).

nicheBrandCountYoyChangePctAtLeastLte.description: The upper limit of the year-on-year change rate of the number of brands (%, with sign).

nicheName.description: Track normalized name fragment (LIKE, snake_case lowercase), suitable for track timing comparison.

nichePeakSearchVolumeAtLeastGte.description: Lower bound for peak monthly search volume.

nichePeakSearchVolumeAtLeastLte.description: The upper bound of peak monthly search volume.

nicheRevenue360dMaxUsdAtLeastGte.description: The minimum value of the 360-day market revenue upper bound (USD).

nicheRevenue360dMaxUsdAtLeastLte.description: The maximum value of the 360-day market revenue upper bound (USD).

nicheRevenue360dMinUsdAtLeastGte.description: The minimum value of the 360-day market revenue lower bound (USD).

nicheRevenue360dMinUsdAtLeastLte.description: The maximum value of the 360-day market revenue lower bound (USD).

nicheSearchVolumeYoyChangePctAtLeastGte.description: The lower limit of the year-on-year change rate of search volume (%, signed).

nicheSearchVolumeYoyChangePctAtLeastLte.description: The upper limit of the year-over-year change rate of search volume (%, signed).

nicheTop5ProductClickSharePctAtLeastGte.description: The lower limit for the click share of the top 5 products.

nicheTop5ProductClickSharePctAtLeastLte.description: The upper limit of the click share of the top 5 products.

priceEntryClickSharePctAtLeastGte.description: Minimum click share for entry-level users.

priceEntryClickSharePctAtLeastLte.description: The entry level click share limit.

priceHighClickSharePctAtLeastGte.description: The lower limit of click share for high-end products.

priceMaxUsdGte.description: The track’s maximum product price limit (USD).

priceMaxUsdLte.description: The track’s maximum product price limit (USD).

priceMinUsdGte.description: The lowest product price limit on the track (USD).

priceMinUsdLte.description: The track’s minimum product price limit (USD).

priceSweetSpotMaxUsdGte.description: Lower bound of Sweet Spot upper limit (USD).

priceSweetSpotMaxUsdLte.description: The upper bound of the Sweet Spot limit (USD).

priceSweetSpotMinUsdGte.description: The lower bound of the Sweet Spot lower limit (USD).

priceSweetSpotMinUsdLte.description: The upper bound of the Sweet Spot lower limit (USD).

reviewNegativeTop1PctAtLeastGte.description: The lower limit of negative review #1 topic proportion (proportion of negative reviews).

reviewNegativeTop1PctAtLeastLte.description: The upper limit for the proportion of negative review #1 topics.

reviewNegativeTop1Topic.description: Negative review #1 topic snippet (snake_case, LIKE), such as `size`, `quality`, `durability`.

reviewPositiveTop1PctAtLeastGte.description: The lower limit of the proportion of positive #1 topics (the proportion of positive comments).

reviewPositiveTop1PctAtLeastLte.description: The upper limit of the proportion of positive #1 topics.

reviewPositiveTop1Topic.description: Like #1 theme snippets (snake_case, LIKE), such as `comfort`, `quality_overall_generic`.

reviewStrategicInsightTagsContains.description: Comment policy suggests tag snippets (snake_case, LIKE), such as `sizing_clarity`, `material_transparency`.

searchTopCategory1Label.description: Search traffic first type target tag fragment (snake_case, LIKE), such as `core_product_terms`, `set_kit_configurations`.
